dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's been a while since I last saw you, Miss Taraneh...

dialogues.speaker: Taraneh
dialogues.text: Ah, didn't expect you to remember me! My performance spot is a bit off the beaten path, after all...

choices.text: I've heard people talking about your dance skills in a few places...

response.speaker: Taraneh
response.text: I'm so grateful to hear that... It's possibly the highest compliment one could receive! I'll keep improving so I can inspire even more people with my dancing.

response.speaker: Taraneh
response.text: The most important thing is to live your life well and share your positivity with everyone around you!

choices.text: Just thinking about your dance lifts my spirits!
